mod.ToolModeBinds: Adds the Mining Laser, Boltcaster and Terrain Manipulator to the Quick Menu weapon list, so you can pick them there and bind them to Ctrl+digit keys. Your secondary weapon stays as it is.
title: NMS.py Mod Manager
steam_note: Steam may show No Man's Sky as running while this window is open. That is the manager, not the game.
gog_note: Play in this window starts the game through NMS.py. Play in GOG Galaxy starts the game without the extras.
mods_help: Install puts that whole folder into GAMEDATA\MODS. Remove takes it back out (the folder stays in NMS.py\parked). Update replaces an older copy already there and keeps its settings. Open Description to read what a mod does. Open Settings under a mod for extras and switches. Those apply next start, or in the in-game window while playing.
rs_mods_help: Install puts the mod folder into GAMEDATA\MODS. Remove parks it in NMS.rs\parked and keeps its settings. Update copies newer files and keeps your settings. The mods load when the game starts, so there is nothing else to launch.
rs_cleanup: Remove leftover Python and the old Steam launch option (Steam may close)
rs_cleanup_help: Deletes the old Python files of the mods that now run as Rust. PulseTweaks stays. Other people's mods are not touched.
rs_side_bar_old: Your Smaller Inventory Slots side bar is from an older version. Press {button} once to add the new filter buttons (Foods, Custom) and the new icons.
rs_cleanup_steam_none: No old Steam launch option ({n} accounts checked).
rs_cleanup_steam_removed: Steam launch option removed on {done} of {n} accounts.
rs_text_size_hint: Makes the text and buttons bigger or smaller. Ctrl and plus or minus work too.
rs_linux_help: On Linux, Steam must load our xinput9_1_0.dll instead of Wine's own. In Steam, open No Man's Sky, Properties, Launch Options, and paste the line below. Without it the game starts but the mods do not load. This build is a beta for Linux: if something fails, use Pack logs in Settings and send the zip.
rs_copied: Copied. Paste it into the Steam launch options.
rs_logs_help: Packs the NMS.rs logs into one zip you can send when something goes wrong.
rs_working_hint: Please wait and keep this window open. The first Apply can take a minute while tools download.
rs_job_stopped: The task stopped unexpectedly. Check NMS.rs\logs\manager.log.
sizes_summary: Sizes: custom transfer-grid and inventory-slot sizes. Close the game before you apply.
sizes_help: This rebuilds Bigger Item Grids and Smaller Inventory Slots from your installed game. Close the game. Shortcuts fill common values. Apply writes the files. The first Apply may download tools and take a minute. A few black tool windows may flash. That is the compiler writing the files, not a virus.
sizes_grid_blurb: Bigger Item Grids: Transfer Items and Craft Product card popup.
columns_hint: vanilla {vanilla}, default {default}, at most {cap} at this window
rows_hint: auto, or a number. At most 99 cards in total.
sizes_slots_blurb: Smaller Inventory Slots: Technology and Cargo grids on the inventory page.
filter_buttons_hint: extra buttons on the inventory page
uninstall_help: Removes the Steam launch option and our mod folders. Type YES, then Uninstall. The NMS.py folder is left for you to delete. Other people's mods are not touched.
load_extras: Load extras (.py). UI files still load if this is off.
no_mods: No mods in this folder yet.
close_game: Close the game first. The manager cannot change files while NMS.exe is running.
last_closed_attaching: Last start: the game closed while the loader was attaching.
last_attach_failed: Last start: attach failed. See launcher.log.
last_no_python: Last start: no extra-feature mods to attach.
play_not_written: Play has not written a start yet.
runtime_missing: Mod runtime missing or needs a reinstall
launch_missing: Steam launch option is not set
clash_yes: {count} UI file(s) still clash. Open conflicts.txt.
outdated: {count} of our mods are older than this copy ({names}).
setup_failed: Setup did not finish. See NMS.py\setup.log.
launch_set: Launch option set. Steam may have closed for a moment.
uninstall_done: Launch option removed. Our mod folders were deleted. Delete the NMS.py folder yourself when you are done. Steam will start the game normally.
building_grid: Building Bigger Item Grids. Leave this window open.
building_slots: Building Smaller Inventory Slots. Leave this window open.
dpg_missing: Dear PyGui is not in this runtime. Text menu follows.
text_subtitle: Changes apply next time you start the game.
win_extras_hint: Python extras are on/off in the Mod Manager.
win_clash_none_yet: Play has not written conflicts.txt yet.
win_clash_yes: Some UI files still clash. Open conflicts.txt.
win_clash_see: See conflicts.txt for what Play merged.
mod.BiggerItemGrids: Bigger card grid on Transfer Items and Craft Product. Change the size in Sizes. Without the extras, the arrows still move several cards at a time.
mod.SmallerInventorySlots: Smaller Technology and Cargo slots on the inventory page, plus extra filter buttons. Change the size in Sizes. Without the extras the new buttons do nothing.
mod.CompactTooltips: Smaller item hover. Game files only.
mod.CompactQuickTransfer: Shorter Quick Transfer list. Game files only.
mod.CraftFromStorage: Craft, build and charge from Storage Containers at this base, and on your freighter while it is in range. Switches cover Anywhere, fossils, refiners, the cooker, and Quick Transfer rows.
mod.QuickTransferAll: Hold Shift (or a bound left trigger), press Quick Transfer, pick a destination. That item goes first, then every other lit item in the same inventory. Deposit and Exosuit lock mode are switches.
mod.SphereSizedMining: The Terrain Manipulator (and Exocraft) yield cap follows the sphere volume. Small is vanilla. You still only get what the sphere cuts out.
mod.TradeUITweaks: Station and galactic trade tweaks: Q jumps to what you can pay, Buy/Sell list memory, and Switch/C can walk nearby inventories. Ingredient Storage and Cold Storage stay off that switch.
mod.QuickRecharge: Charge menu can spend fuel on every listed technology. Free fill is off by default. Optional sound and notice.
mod.HideEmptyHover: Hides the Modify panel over an empty cargo or tech slot. Click still opens Craft / Modify.
mod.GalaxyMapFilters: Extra galaxy map filters: star colours, pirate, abandoned and gas giant systems. Matching stars light up and the rest are dimmed.
mod.PulseTweaks: Pulse Engine tweaks. Not in the current zip.
mod.NMSrsMenu: Adds the Mods row to the pause menu. Park it to remove only that row; the Mods row in the main menu Options still works.
mod.PickerTweaks: Search the item pickers and type amounts instead of using the arrows.
mod.RefinerGuard: Refuses to move a refiner that still holds items, so the game cannot delete them. Shows a notice instead.
mig_intro: NMS.rs replaces the old Python loader. Migrate now cleans it up for you. A backup goes to NMS.rs\backup first.
mig_item_python: {count} old Python files in our mods ({names})
mig_item_option: The old Steam launch option (Steam may close for a moment)
mig_keep_text: Your mod settings (.json), lua files you edited, PulseTweaks, other people's mods and the game files. Your NMS.py language, merge order, sizes and parked mods move to NMS.rs.
mig_later_hint: Not now hides this until the next start. You can also migrate later in Settings.
mig_found: Old NMS.py files found. Migrate removes them after a backup.
mig_nothing: Nothing to migrate: no old NMS.py setup found.
mig_no_stock: NMS.rs\stock is missing. Extract the whole NMS.rs zip into the game folder first.
mig_kept_edited: Kept your edited files (Update on the Mods tab replaces them)
mig_steam_failed: The old Steam launch option is still set
mig_py_partial: Could not delete {names}: something still has them open, probably the old NMS.py Mod Manager window. Close it, then press Migrate now again to finish
mig_py_open: The old NMS.py Mod Manager (or another NMS.py window) is still open: {names}. Close it, then press Migrate now again.
mig_nothing_changed: Nothing was backed up or changed.
mig_py_kept_steam: NMS.py folder kept, because Steam still starts the game through it
mig_why_game_root: this is not a game folder (no Binaries\NMS.exe)
mig_why_name: its name is not exactly NMS.py
mig_why_link: it is a link or junction to another place
mig_why_place: it is not directly in the game folder
mig_why_layout: it does not look like the old NMS.py folder
mig_kept: Kept: your mod settings, edited files, PulseTweaks, other people's mods and the game files
mig_done: Migration finished. Start the game as usual.
mig_partly: Migration not finished. See the lines above.
mig_stopped: Migration stopped here. Nothing else was changed.
mig_undo: Undo: copy the folders in {path} back into the game folder (list in manifest.txt).
